description: What changes between the installed version of ONE dependency and a target: changelog per release, breaking changes, deprecations, security fixes, and this project's files that import it. Call before upgrading or bumping a dependency.

ecosystem.description: Registry. Default: inferred from the project's dependencies (required when the name exists in more than one).

from_version.description: Current version. Default: the version this project's lockfile resolves.

package.description: Package name exactly as published (npm: `zod`, `@scope/pkg`; crates.io: `fastembed`; PyPI: the distribution, `PyYAML`; Go: the module path, `github.com/jackc/pgx/v5`).

response_format.description: concise (default): every breaking/deprecation/security entry plus up to 3 others per version. detailed: all entries, capped at 400.

to_version.description: Target version. Default: the highest stable version on the registry.

name: upgrade_impact
title: Upgrade impact
